description: Draws a branching tree on the panel, with its shape and colour set by knob or by voltage

params.text: Sets how far each branch turns away from the one it grew from, 0 to 90 degrees
Sets the colour the tree is drawn in
Sets how much shorter each branch is than the one it grew from
Sets how long the first pair of branches is
Sets how tall the trunk is
Draws the tree again with random amounts added to every turn
Sets how large the random amounts a jitter adds are, -5V to +5V

inputs.text: A trigger here draws the tree again with random amounts added to every turn
Added to the jitter amount knob

notes: the right-hand edge of the module can be dragged to make it wider

inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
